The regular and destroyed FBX variants and all supplied diffuse textures were
copied unchanged from the archive. The second outer-wasteland sector uses the
destroyed variant as a strategic-map evacuation-convoy wreck. Its supplied
textures must remain assigned; the model must not be recoloured with a proxy
material.
